t: United Nations Mission of Observers in Tajikistan - Wikipedia
s: September 7, 2024 - The United Nations Mission of Observers in Tajikistan (UNMOT) was a peacekeeping mission established by the United Nations Security Council in December 1994, and its mandate expired in May 2000. Its purpose was to monitor peace agreements during and after the Tajikistan Civil War.
